Warn.NoPermission: You don't have permission to edit animations on this scene.
Warn.NoAnimation: Animation not found on this scene.
Warn.NoTokens: No tokens to animate. Assign tokens to the animation, or select some on the map.
Warn.NoSteps: This animation has no enabled steps yet. Draw a path first.
Warn.GMOnly: Only a Gamemaster can open the animator panel.
Warn.SelectTokens: Select one or more tokens on the map first.
Warn.NoCopies: Symmetry copies need permission to create tokens; playing without copies.
Warn.NeedsTarget: This animation flies to targets: target one or more tokens (T) first.
Warn.NotAllowed: You aren't allowed to play this animation (the GM chooses who can, in its Tokens tab).

Info.MinNodes: A path needs at least two nodes (three for a closed loop).
Info.DrawNow: Now draw the path on the map. Click to place nodes, drag to pull curves, then click the first node to close it or press Enter to finish.
Info.SavedToLibrary: Template "{name}" saved. Find it under My templates in the template gallery.
Info.Converted: Converted into an editable curve. Drag its nodes and handles freely.

Pick.Tokens: Click tokens on the map to assign or unassign them. Press Esc when done.
Pick.FacePoint: Click the point on the map tokens should face.
Pick.TargetGroup: Click tokens to add or remove them from the target group. Press Esc when done.
Pick.SymPoint: Click the point the symmetry copies should turn around.
Pick.AnchorToken: Click the token this animation should follow.
Pick.HomingToken: Click the token this homing leg should fly to.

InterruptOnMove.Name: Manual movement interrupts animation
InterruptOnMove.Hint: If a playing token is dragged or moved by hand, its animation stops and it moves normally from where it visibly is.

PlayersCanPlay.Name: Players can play animations
PlayersCanPlay.Hint: Lets players use the Token HUD to play, pause and stop the animations assigned to tokens they own.

StartLead.Name: Start sync delay (ms)
StartLead.Hint: Playback starts this many milliseconds in the future so every connected client begins on the exact same frame. Raise it on slow connections.

ShowRunning.Name: Show running paths on the map
ShowRunning.Hint: GM only: keep the paths of playing animations visible even when the animator tools are not active.

Keys.PauseAll: Pause / resume all animations on the scene
Keys.StopAll: Stop all animations on the scene
